text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: 如何获取 DeepSeek API Key

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: 5 步完成 · 全程约 3 分钟 · 官方平台，不装任何软件

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: How to get a DeepSeek API key — five steps, about three minutes, official platform only

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: 打开 DeepSeek 开放平台

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: 浏览器访问 platform.deepseek.com（官方唯一入口，认准这个域名）。

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Open platform.deepseek.com in your browser — the only official entry.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Tip: 不要从搜索引擎广告位进，避免钓鱼站点 / avoid sponsored search ads.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: 用手机号或邮箱注册，完成登录；已有账号直接登录即可。

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Sign up with your phone number or email, then sign in.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: 进入「充值」页按提示充值（按量计费，先充少量就够试用）。

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Top up your balance — pay-as-you-go, a small amount is enough to start.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: 左侧「API keys」→「创建 API key」→ 命名 → 复制（完整内容只显示一次）。

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Create an API key and copy it — it is shown in full only once, so save it now.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: 粘贴到 MTNode 并验证

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: 把 Key 粘到本窗口输入框 → 点「验证并保存」，通过后自动写入 DeepSeek 供应商。

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Paste the key into this window and click "Verify & save" — it is stored only after it verifies.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: 验证请求只读模型列表，不消耗 Token；Key 只存在本机配置里，不上传 MTNode。 / Verification costs no tokens; the key stays on this machine.
